purpose: Under-deck TMD at midspan of 40 m footbridge: half-sine first bending mode, mass on springs and dampers hung below girders, deck top unchanged
code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4))
import numpy as np
x=np.linspace(0,40,200); mode=np.sin(np.pi*x/40)
ax.plot(x, mode*2, label='1st bending mode ~1.9 Hz')
ax.plot([0,40],[0,0],'k-')
ax.fill_between([0,40],[0,0.2], color='gray', alpha=0.3)
ax.text(20,0.35,'deck top unchanged',ha='center')
# TMD box at midspan below
ax.plot([19,21,21,19,19],[ -0.2,-0.2,-0.8,-0.8,-0.2],'k-')
ax.text(20,-0.5,'TMD mass',ha='center')
ax.plot([19.3,19.3],[0, -0.2],'k-');ax.plot([20.7,20.7],[0,-0.2],'k-')
ax.text(18.2,-0.1,'spring+damper',fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel('span along bridge [m]');ax.set_ylabel('vertical shape')
ax.set_title('Under-deck TMD at midspan antinode')
plt.tight_layout();plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150)
